    raise ValueError(f"Could not find information for hotel: {hotel_name}")

# I need to parse this string to get the numeric rating.
hotel_info = rating_reviews.get(hotel_name)

if not hotel_info:
    raise ValueError(f"No information found for hotel: {hotel_name}")

# Use AI assistant to parse the rating and reviews
class HotelRatingInfo(BaseModel):
    rating: float
    reviews: str

parsed_info = query_ai_assistant(
    f"Extract the rating (as a float) and the reviews text from the following hotel information. \n\nHotel Info: {hotel_info}",
    HotelRatingInfo
)

print(f"Rating for {hotel_name}: {parsed_info.rating}")
print(f"Reviews: {parsed_info.reviews}")

# Check if rating is higher than 4
if parsed_info.rating > 4:
    # Make a reservation
    start_day = "2025-01-11"

    reservation_result = reserve_hotel(hotel_name, start_day, end_day)
